headers.why: Public profile buttons/icons now put the user-saved link straight in href (buttons.blade.php, icons.blade.php) instead of the /going redirect; saved links aren't scheme-checked, so any user can save a javascript: link that runs in visitors'/admins' browsers. A security hole through saved data, which is inside plain's stated scope.

The broken functions.php (parse error) is a build problem the note excuses, but the commit also lets any logged-in user upload SVG avatars/backgrounds (config/validation.php image_extensions adds 'svg'; import-data writes raw .svg), which is stored XSS against admins. That's a who-can-do-what problem. Admin edit-user also now rejects an empty password.

New JSON search API lists every user's playlists (Playlist.search unscoped in search_controller.rb and search/playlists_controller.rb; JSON includes owner user_id), while the rest of the app scopes playlists to Current.user. A who-can-see-what leak.

headers.why: Saved-data design flaws the owner should hear about before building on it: @@unique([companyId, primary]) caps a company at two bank accounts (one primary, one not), and account/routing numbers are stored as plain text. Nothing uses the table yet, so it's misleading rather than wrong.
Remaining problems are API docs vs validation mismatch (max 250 documented, 50 enforced; shares reads `take`, not `limit`). None of that is access, money, saved data or secrets.

Breaking rename of admin request fields (roles->role_ids etc.) is a frontend/deploy compatibility issue, not access/money/data/secrets. Auth is unchanged. The card also says it can't describe the server changes.
Only problems are a leftover debug \Log::error line (Thread.php) and links opening in the same tab. Both fall outside the four areas.

headers.header: ✓ Nothing flagged · 8 steps before you ship
headers.why: Money figures go wrong: the overview drops ?active=true and calculatePaidCount only zeroes subscriptions with a cancelled_at, so every subscription switched off before this commit counts as paid again. That inflates the spent/subscription totals.

Adds DELETE /api/v1/me, which permanently deletes the caller's account and all their posts with no password re-check. It is login-only and only touches the caller's own account, so it's no open hole, but this is irreversible saved-data deletion done non-atomically (comments/likes/chats are orphaned, and it can fail half-way). The owner should be told.

The real problem is a deploy-script typo (installs sasl_password, postmaps sasl_passwd), which the note excuses. The SMTP credential is not committed (no sasl file in the repo), so no secret is exposed.

Both problem lines are true: pages/documents/[id]/index.tsx imports redaction-launcher and redactions/[jobId].tsx imports redaction-workspace, and ee/features/redaction doesn't exist at this commit, so the build fails. Incomplete: document-header.tsx also imports two more missing redaction dialogs.
